name: Mitsuki
source:
A voluptuous woman of indeterminate age who is Kiichi's frequent target. She's been molested many times by Kiichi, but isn't resistant to his advances as she's already addicted to the pleasure from his techniques.

[Spoiler] Ujihashi's wife of over twenty years and an acupuncturist by trade. She eventually learns Kiichi's name after he joins the Vatican and will happily meet up with him for sex. The age gap between herself and her husband leads Kiichi to guess that she's in her thirties or forties, even though she doesn't look her age. 

Her acupuncture treatment relieves the paralysis and loss of strength in Kiichi's arms by increasing his natural recovery and energy reserves. 

When Kiichi is caught by the transport police assault squad in the station, she intervenes and buys him enough time to board the ark to escape. [/Spoiler]
